job-4458184450.source_description:
Hybrid, Garching near Munich

From early mornings on the mountain to fast-paced studio shoots – this is a role where no two productions look the same. As a Producer for Atomic, one of Amer Sports’ iconic winter sports brands, you’ll make sure great ideas become great content, coordinating everything from the first production plans to the final delivery. This position requires on-site presence at Atomic’s headquarters in Altenmarkt im Pongau, Austria, two days per week, ensuring close collaboration with the team and effective alignment across productions.

What you will be doing


 * Coordinate photo and video productions from start to finish – from the initial production plan through on-set coordination and post-production to final delivery.
 * Manage the production behind the scenes – coordinate locations, travel, equipment, products, samples, crew and freelancers, and make sure all the right people and resources are in place.
 * Be hands-on during productions – support shoots on snow and in the studio, coordinate logistics on site and find quick solutions when plans change.
 * Keep productions on track – manage timelines, deliverables and production-related costs, and proactively flag risks or delays.
 * Coordinate post-production and asset delivery – work with photographers, videographers and other partners to manage feedback rounds and final deliveries.
 * Manage Atomic’s content assets – ensure photo and video content is properly organized and accessible in our DAM system (Aprimo) and support clear content handovers to markets.
 * Work across teams and partners – collaborate closely with Art Directors, Brand Operations, Sports Marketing, internal teams, agencies, freelancers and production partners.
 * Support the operational side of content production – including product and sample coordination, ordering and production-related administration.
   
   

What you need to succeed


 * Around 2+ years of experience in content, photo/video production, production coordination or a similar creative environment.
 * A solid understanding of production workflows and what it takes to bring a project from briefing through shooting to final delivery.
 * Strong organizational and project management skills, with a hands-on, proactive approach and the ability to keep multiple projects moving.
 * Confident communication skills and the ability to work with creative teams, agencies, freelancers and other production partners.
 * Good digital skills and experience with project management, production or asset management tools; Asana or Aprimo experience is a plus.
 * A good understanding of the business behind content and how content supports the brand, products and markets.
 * A genuine passion for skiing and winter sports and an understanding of the culture, products and world behind the sport.
 * Willingness to travel regularly for productions (around 30%), including international and on-snow shoots, and flexibility when production schedules require it.
   
   

What’s in it for you

At Amer Sports, you’ll be part of a global community of people who care about what they do and how they do it. Across our teams and brands, we are driven by ambition, collaboration, and a shared purpose of elevating the world through sport.


 * Employee product benefits: Enjoy access to employee discounts on quality products from our iconic brands.
 * Global collaboration: Work with diverse, international teams and collaborate across brands, functions, and markets, learning from different perspectives along the way.
 * Access to a global network of leading brands: Work within a global collective of iconic sports and outdoor brands, gaining exposure to different businesses, perspectives, and opportunities across Amer Sports.
 * We’re in the game together: Join a culture built on trust, support, and shared responsibility, where progress is achieved together and success is celebrated as a team.
 * Purpose‑driven environment: Be part of work that supports healthier, more active lives through our iconic sports and outdoor brands.
 * Small teams, real impact: Contribute in small, trusted teams within a global company, where your ideas matter and your work can create real impact.
 * Excellence in how we work: Join an environment where quality, innovation, and continuous improvement matter, and where people are encouraged to raise the bar in how work is done.
 * Ambitious career development: Develop your skills through meaningful work, new challenges, and collaboration with experienced colleagues.
 * Modern technologies and ways of working: Be part of teams that work with modern technologies and continuously evolve how we build, operate, and improve our digital solutions.
   
   

What to expect from the recruitment process


 * CV screening: Every CV is reviewed by a human.
 * Phone screening: A conversation with Amer Sports’ HR manager to discuss the role, our organization, and your expectations.
 * Interviews: Usually 2–4 rounds, including interviews with the hiring manager and prospective team.
 * Case studies or assessments: Your role may require practical tests, such as presentations or case studies.
 * Feedback and decision: We aim to provide feedback throughout the process.
   
   

Interested?

Please submit your application via the application form. CVs sent by email will not be considered or processed.

If you have any questions or need clarification at any stage of the application process or during your journey with us, please don't hesitate to reach out to [redacted-email] (HR). Apply and join us in striving for excellence at each step!

job-4462961258.source_description:
Werden Sie Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte und gestalten Sie die Weiterentwicklung unseres Boutique-Teams hinsichtlich Brand Image und Business Performance aktiv mit. Wir suchen für unsere CHANEL Fashion Boutique München zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine:n Learning Manager (m/w/d) in Vollzeit, unbefristet.

YOUR IMPACT:



 * Weiterentwicklung und Förderung unseres Münchener Boutique-Teams in den Bereichen Fashion Expertise und Client Experience
 * Konzeption und Durchführung inspirierender, individueller Learning Sessions und Team-Coachings, die auf die Bedürfnisse und strategischen Prioritäten der Boutique abgestimmt sind
 * Begleitung eines erfolgreichen Onboardings neuer Mitarbeitender in der Boutique
 * Bereitstellung und Weiterentwicklung von Trainingsformaten in Zusammenarbeit mit dem Boutique Management sowie dem Fashion Training Team
 * Förderung des Austauschs von Best Practices innerhalb der Europe Learning Community sowie aktive Mitgestaltung einer nachhaltigen Lernkultur
 * Nutzung von KPIs, um die vielfältigen Fähigkeiten im Boutique-Team sichtbar zu machen und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten herauszuarbeiten
 * Unterstützung bei strategischen Initiativen und Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung einer außergewöhnlichen Client Experience
   
   
   

 

YOUR ENERGIZERS:



 * Faszination für Mode, Stil und Luxus
 * Freude an der Verbindung von analytischem Denken, Projektmanagement und der Mitgestaltung von Teamentwicklung
 * Leidenschaft dafür, Potenziale zu erkennen und erfolgreich weiterzuentwickeln
 * Begeisterung für die Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Teams und Ansprechpartner:innen
   
   
   

  

YOUR PROFILE:



 * Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium mit Erfahrung im Luxus-Retail-Umfeld
 * Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke sowie die Fähigkeit, andere zu inspirieren und für neue Perspektiven zu begeistern
 * Analytische und kund:innenorientierte Denkweise
 * Proaktive und organisierte Persönlichkeit, gepaart mit digitaler Affinität und sicherem Umgang mit MS Office
 * Reisebereitschaft (gelegentlich)
 * Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; weitere Fremdsprachen sind von Vorteil
   
   
   

OUR BENEFITS:



 * Teamzusammenhalt und eine inspirierende Unternehmenskultur
 * Langfristige Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einem internationalen Unternehmen sowie regelmäßige Trainings
 * Wellbeing-Angebote (u. a. Zuschuss für Lunch, Styling, Sprachlern- oder Sportprogramme)
 * Eigenes Diensthandy (iPhone)
 * Exklusive Konditionen für unsere Fashion- und Beauty-Produkte
 * Sechs Wochen Urlaub, ein Wellbeing Day sowie zwei weitere Tage für Social Volunteering
   
   
   

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (inklusive Arbeits- und Ausbildungszeugnissen, Angabe zur aktuellen Kündigungsfrist sowie Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung) über unser Online-Bewerbungsformular.

At Chanel, we are focused on creating an inclusive culture that nurtures personal growth, contributing to collective progress. We believe the uniqueness of each individual increases the diversity, complementarity and effectiveness of our teams. We strongly encourage your application, as we value the perspective, experience and potential you could bring to CHANEL.

Wir sind ein Team von mehr als 15.000 engagierten Experten, Machern und Innovatoren. Die Zukunft zu gestalten, bedeutet für uns, Unternehmen in Bewegung zu halten. Als Global Player, der mit dem Geist und der Geschwindigkeit eines mittelständischen Champions agiert, bietet uns die Zukunft unbegrenzte Möglichkeiten. job-4470874731.source_description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Social Media Coordinator who lives online in the best way: someone who knows what's moving culture before it hits the group chat, has opinions about grid layouts and caption length, and can tell the difference between content that's just posted and content that actually lands.




You'll own the day-to-day of how our studio shows up in the world, across social, our website, and beyond. That means turning our work, our people, and our point of view into content that feels as considered as the projects themselves. You'll work closely with our creative, production, and leadership teams, chasing down the good stuff and making sure it gets seen.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 * Run the social calendar: planning, scheduling, publishing, and keeping our channels alive and consistent.
 * Hunt down the assets. Imagery, video, credits, behind-the-scenes moments. You'll know what exists, where it lives, and what we still need.
 * Make social-first content for project launches, case studies, BTS, studio life, and team moments, built for how people actually scroll.
 * Write copy with taste. Captions, project descriptions, and web content that sound like us: sharp, clear, never try-hard.
 * Work with designers to build, adapt, and resize assets across platforms, and jump in yourself when it's faster.
 * Keep our website current with new work, project pages, team updates, and news.
 * Spot the stories. Know which projects, moments, and people deserve the spotlight, and follow up until you have what you need.
 * Build and maintain an asset library so the good stuff is always easy to find.
 * Watch the numbers, understand what's resonating and why, and bring those learnings back to the team.
 * Stay plugged into platforms, formats, creative trends, and cultural conversations, and bring us ideas before they're everywhere.
 * Pitch in on broader studio marketing and comms as needed.




REQUIREMENTS

 * 1–2 years in social, content, marketing, or comms. Bonus points if it's been at an agency, design studio, production company, or in fashion, entertainment, or another creative industry.
 * Fluent in Instagram and LinkedIn, and you know a post that works on one rarely works on the other without changes.
 * Culturally tuned in: you follow designers, directors, brands, and studios, and you have real opinions about what's good.
 * A strong writer with an ear for tone, story, and detail.
 * A real visual eye and genuine interest in design, art, fashion, tech, entertainment, and/or experiential work.
 * Working proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Premiere, and/or After Effects) and Figma. You can resize, adapt, and edit assets without waiting on a designer.
 * Comfortable with AI tools and curious about how they can speed up and push content creation, from copy and editing to research and workflow.
 * Highly organized. You can juggle multiple projects, deadlines, and people without dropping anything.
 * Unafraid to chase. You'll follow up with busy creative teams (nicely, persistently) to keep content moving.
 * Familiarity with website CMS platforms and social scheduling/analytics tools is a plus.
 * Proactive, collaborative, and hungry to grow in a fast-moving creative environment.

Vapiano steht für frische, handgemachte Küche und ein unkompliziertes, mediterranes Lebensgefühl. In unserem Restaurant in Mönchengladbach sorgen wir dafür, dass Gäste genau das erleben: ehrliche Pasta, Pizza, Salate – schnell, frisch und mit echter Gastfreundschaft.


Unsere Gäste sind vielfältig, unsere Ansprüche klar: Qualität, Tempo und ein Team, das Bock darauf hat, Menschen glücklich zu machen.


Hast du Lust, unser Restaurant nach vorne zu bringen, Gäste zu begeistern und gemeinsam dafür zu sorgen, dass Vapiano Mönchengladbach der Laden ist, zu dem man gerne zurückkommt?


Für unser Team vor Ort suchen wir genau DICH!


Aufgaben


   
   
 * Du unterstützt die Geschäftsführung im Tagesgeschäft und hältst ihr den Rücken frei.
   
   
 * Du koordinierst interne Abläufe und sorgst dafür, dass Organisation, Kommunikation und Prioritäten klar stehen.
   
   
 * Du übernimmst administrative Aufgaben: Terminplanung, Dokumentation, Auswertungen, interne Kommunikation.
   
   
 * Du unterstützt bei Personalthemen wie Dienstplanung, Bewerbungskoordination und Onboarding.

 * Du kümmerst dich um Bestellungen, Lieferantenkommunikation und die Sicherstellung eines reibungslosen Betriebs.
   
   
 * Du packst im operativen Tagesgeschäft dort mit an, wo es nötig ist – ohne Allüren.
   
   
 * Du sorgst dafür, dass Standards eingehalten werden, und identifizierst Optimierungen im Ablauf.
   
   





Qualifikation


   
   
 * Ein abgeschlossenes Bachelorstudium (z. B. BWL, Hospitality Management, Wirtschaftswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung.
   
   
 * 3–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise in Gastronomie, Hotellerie, Systemgastronomie oder in einer Rolle mit Führungs- oder Schichtverantwortung.
   
   
 * Sicherer Umgang mit betrieblichen Abläufen, Kennzahlen, Personalthemen und Organisation.
   
   
 * Du hast bereits Verantwortung übernommen – Dienstpläne, Warenbestellung, Teamkoordination, Abläufe optimieren.
   
   
 * Du kannst nicht nur „Office“, sondern auch Operatives: Du scheust dich nicht davor, im Tagesgeschäft mit anzupacken.
   
   
 * Struktur, Überblick und Prioritäten setzen gehören zu deinen natürlichen Stärken.
   
   
 * Du trittst professionell, ruhig und verbindlich auf – vor Gästen, im Team und gegenüber der Geschäftsführung.
   
   
 * Du arbeitest eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und entscheidungsfreudig, ohne Drama, ohne Hin-und-Her.
   
   





Benefits


   
   
 * Flexibel arbeiten: Arbeitszeiten, die sich gut mit deinem Alltag arrangieren lassen.
   
   
 * Leckeres extra: Essenszuschuss + kostenlose Getränke während deiner Schicht.
   
   
 * Mehr für dich: Mitarbeiterrabatte auf unser komplettes Sortiment.
   
   
 * Weiterkommen: Betriebliche Weiterbildungen, damit du dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickelst.

job-4471292096.source_description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a [People] Hunter / Talent Acquisition Assistant based in Germany.

This remote role offers an opportunity to support a fast-paced, global talent acquisition operation while developing hands-on recruitment expertise. You will contribute to candidate sourcing, screening, engagement, interview coordination, and pipeline management. The position is designed for someone who already has recruitment or talent acquisition experience and enjoys working in a high-output environment. You will communicate with candidates across professional platforms and help maintain accurate recruitment tracking. The role also provides exposure to the crypto and Web3 sector, along with opportunities to learn from an international team. Strong performance can lead to increased earnings and potential progression into a full-time talent acquisition position.

Accountabilities


 * Support the talent acquisition team with candidate sourcing and resume screening.
 * Identify and engage potential candidates through LinkedIn and other relevant sourcing platforms.
 * Help coordinate interviews and maintain organized candidate pipelines.
 * Keep recruitment trackers and related records accurate and up to date.
 * Communicate recruitment progress and provide regular status updates to the team.
 * Commit consistent daily hours to support a high-output recruitment operation.
 * Contribute proactively to recruitment activities and help maintain an efficient candidate pipeline.
   
   

Requirements


 * Proven professional experience in talent acquisition or recruitment is mandatory.
 * Strong interest in the crypto and Web3 industry.
 * Ability to commit consistent daily working hours and operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
 * Strong candidate sourcing and communication skills.
 * Good organizational skills and attention to detail when managing recruitment pipelines and trackers.
 * Responsible, proactive, and task-oriented approach to work.
 * Ability to work independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively with a global team.
 * Candidates without prior talent acquisition or recruitment experience will not be considered.
   
   

Benefits


 * Base pay of USDT 500 per month.
 * Commission for each successful hire, with top performers potentially earning USDT 2,000+ per month.
 * Remote work across APAC and Europe.
 * Flexible opportunity with a preference for full-time engagement.
 * Hands-on experience within a global recruitment operation.
 * Mentorship and professional growth opportunities within the crypto and fintech space.
 * Clear commission structure tied to successful hiring outcomes.
 * Potential opportunity to transition into a full-time Talent Acquisition Assistant position.
 * Professional development support through a study and growth fund.
 * Internal team-building activities, workshops, and events.
 * Collaboration with an international and diverse team.
 * Career advancement and internal mobility opportunities.
   
   

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

job-4471538472.source_description:
Das Amtsgericht Celle sucht zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt eine/n

Justizangestellte/Justizangestellten (m/w/d) im Wachtmeisterdienst

(Entgeltgruppe 4 TV-L).

Der Arbeitsvertrag ist vorerst zeitlich befristet für ein Jahr ab Vertragsbeginn.

Aufgaben:

Die vielfältigen Aufgaben ergeben sich aus der Dienstverordnung für den Justizwachtmeisterdienst - AV des MJ vom 07.12.2019 (Nds. Rpfl. 2020, S. 31) in der aktuellen Fassung.

Diese sind unter anderem:


 * Gewährung der Sicherheit innerhalb des Gerichts,
 * Vorführ- und Sitzungsdienst (Gefangene körperlich durchsuchen und ggfs. fesseln, Begleiten der Gefangenen zu Gerichtsverhandlungen, Beaufsichtigung der Gefangenen während der Verhandlung; Einschreiten bei Fluchtversuchen etc.; Vornahme von Besucherkontrollen und -durchsuchungen)
 * Durchführung von Einlass- bzw. Personenkontrollen
 * Bearbeitung des Postein- und ausgangs (Brief- und e-Post) einschließlich der Digitalisierung von Dokumenten (Scantätigkeiten)
 * Aktenzu- und -abtrag
 * Auskunftsdienste/Pförtnerdienst
 * ggf. die Wahrnehmung von Hausdienstgeschäften (Hausmeistertätigkeit)
   
   

Qualifikation:


 * Gewähr für das Einstehen für die freiheitlich demokratische Grundordnung,
 * mindestens ein guter Hauptschulabschluss UND
 * eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung (handwerklicher Beruf oder Vorerfahrungen im Sicherheitsbereich von Vorteil)
 * Deutsche Staatsangehörigkeit i.S.d. Artikels 116 Abs. 1 GG (
 * 7 Abs. 2 BeamtStG) oder Staatsangehörigkeit eines Mitgliedslandes der EU (ist nur für den Fall der späteren Verbeamtung erforderlich)
 * Sichere Beherrschung der deutschen Sprache in Wort und Schrift
 * Keine Eintragungen im Bundeszentralregister und im Schuldnerverzeichnis
 * Bereitschaft zur amtsärztlichen Untersuchung
 * Hohe Kooperations- und Kommunikationsbereitschaft sowie
 * Teamfähigkeit
 * Zuverlässigkeit,
 * Belastbarkeit,
 * Konflikt- und Problemlösefähigkeit
 * Eigeninitiative,
 * Flexibilität
 * Sicherer Umgang mit Menschen
 * Bereitschaft zur Aus- und Fortbildung, einschließlich Fortbildung in EDV-Anwendungen.
   
   

Es wird darauf hingewiesen, dass die erforderliche körperliche Fitness durch Vorlage des Deutschen Sportabzeichens (mindestens in Bronze und nicht älter als zwei Jahre / ohne Nachweis der Schwimmfertigkeit) innerhalb der Bewerbungsfrist nachzuweisen ist. Bewerbende mit Behinderung können den Nachweis durch Vorlage des Deutschen Sportabzeichens für Menschen mit Behinderung bzw. durch eine entsprechende Bescheinigung über das Absolvieren je einer Übung in den Disziplinen Ausdauer, Kraft, Schnelligkeit und Koordination erbringen.

Schwerbehinderte Bewerberinnen und Bewerber werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Um dieses Interesse zu wahren, ist es erforderlich, einen entsprechenden Nachweis der Bewerbung beizufügen. In jedem Fall wird um einen Hinweis auf eine mögliche Schwerbehinderung oder Gleichstellung gebeten.

Das Land Niedersachsen fördert verstärkt die berufliche Entwicklung von Frauen bzw. Männern in den Bereichen, in denen sie unterrepräsentiert sind. Deswegen werden Bewerbungen von Frauen ausdrücklich begrüßt.

Ihrem Bewerbungsschreiben fügen Sie bitte folgende Unterlagen bei:


 * Lebenslauf mit beruflichem Werdegang,
 * Ablichtung des letzten Schulzeugnisses,
 * Ausbildungsnachweis/Nachweis einer abgeschlossenen Berufsausbildung,
 * Sämtliche Zeugnisse über Beschäftigungen nach der Schulentlassung.
   
   

Ihre Bewerbung richten Sie bitte an:

Amtsgericht Celle

Der Direktor

Frau stellv. Geschäftsleiterin

Mühlenstraße 8

29221 Celle

oder E-Mail: [redacted-email]

Wir bitten um Verständnis, dass unvollständige Bewerberunterlagen, insbesondere fehlende Nachweise von Ausbildungsabschlüssen unter Umständen dazu führen, dass Sie im Auswahlverfahren nicht berücksichtigt werden können.

Bewerbungskosten können nicht erstattet werden.

Datenschutz:

Zur Vorbereitung und zur Durchführung des Bewerbungsverfahrens werden Ihre Daten in einer Übersicht vorübergehend erhoben. Die Löschung der Daten erfolgt zu gegebener Zeit nach

Abschluss des Auswahlverfahrens. Hinweise (Art. 13 DS-GVO) zum Datenschutz und zu Ihren Rechten finden Sie in unserer Datenschutzerklärung unter: Datenschutz Amtsgericht Celle

(niedersachsen.de).

Auf Wunsch werden wir Ihnen die Datenschutzerklärung zusenden.

Informationen

 * Amtsgericht Celle 29221 Celle

Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt

2600 AGCE-E I/2026

16.10.2026

job-4471703423.source_description:
Skeleton Technologies is looking for a Social Media Specialist to join our team in Estonia or Germany.

About Skeleton

Skeleton Technologies is a global leader in critical power infrastructure for AI data centers and electrical grid stability, founded in 2009. Power today is more than electricity.

It is national security, digital continuity, and economic resilience. Skeleton is the Backbone of Power: equipping AI data centers, electrical grids, defense systems, and critical infrastructure with the resilience to withstand surges, instability, and failure. Our power systems protect GPU clusters from millisecond-level spikes, enable hyperscalers to run at higher rack densities without grid compromise, and make AI data centers up to more 40% energy efficient. We keep the lights on when grids fluctuate, stabilising electrical infrastructure under the combined pressure of accelerating renewable energy deployment and surging AI demand.

When power fails, critical operations stop. We exist to prevent that in microseconds. Powering the infrastructure that powers everything else.

Responsibilities


 * Manage the CEO's LinkedIn presence and personal brand, adapting to his tone and style
 * Manage the company LinkedIn page, sharing company news and updates
 * Own and maintain the content calendar two to three weeks ahead, including events and external engagements across the C-suite
 * Develop content ideas that build brand awareness and credibility for Skeleton
 * Follow up with senior stakeholders to secure timely input, approvals and decisions
 * Support the company's X presence as needed
 * Carry out basic website updates and support wider marketing activities
 * Track what content performs well and use it to shape future content
 * Work directly with the CEO and the marketing and communications team
   
   

Requirements


 * Hands-on experience managing LinkedIn content, ideally including an executive's or founder's personal brand
 * An understanding of what type of content works on LinkedIn for a B2B company
 * A broader digital marketing or marketing background is an advantage
 * Experience with X is a plus; paid social experience is a plus but not required
 * Highly organized, with a reliable track record of meeting deadlines
 * Comfortable receiving direct, fast-paced feedback from senior leadership and adapting quickly
 * Persistent and confident in following up with senior stakeholders to get answers
 * Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, with flexibility to occasionally work outside standard hours
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Estonian or German is a plus
 * A portfolio is welcome but not required
   
   

Benefits


 * We offer flexible working hours, with the possibility of mobile working without core working hours and sufficient freedom for your own ideas
 * A flat hierarchy culture - fostering our great working atmosphere
 * A motivating opportunity for continuous growth at Skeleton
 * An additional day off every year for your birthday

job-4473270212.source_description:
Location : LYON, FRANCE

About ARCHIMED

With offices in Europe, North America and Asia, ARCHIMED is a leading investment firm focused exclusively on healthcare industries. Its mix of operational, medical, scientific and financial expertise allows ARCHIMED to serve as both a strategic and financial partner to healthcare businesses. Prioritized areas of focus include Animal & Environmental Health, Biopharma Products, Consumer Health, Diagnostics, Healthcare IT, Life Science Tools & Services and MedTech.

ARCHIMED helps partners internationalize, acquire, innovate and expand their products and services. ARCHIMED manages €9 billion across its various funds, including the largest healthcare-only private equity fund raised by a European-based General Partner. Since inception, ARCHIMED has been a committed Impact investor, both directly and through its EURÊKA Foundation.

The Team


 * An international team (with more than 40 nationalities) with complementary education and experience in the investment, medical, scientific, strategic and operational sectors
 * Composed of alumni from: INSEAD, Berkeley, Georgetown, Bocconi, HEC Paris, Ponts et Chaussées, ESSEC, Imperial College, Dartmouth, etc.
 * Professional backgrounds: Private Equity (3i, Siparex, USS Ltd, Barings, capiton), Consulting (A.T. Kearney, Bain, McKinsey), M&A (Lazard, EY, KPMG, PwC), Industry (Biotronik, Cerba, Pharmacy, Veterinary)
   
   

Your Role

Location: Lyon, France

Duration: 6 months

Start Date : January 2027

We are looking for a highly motivated intern to join our HR team in Lyon, France. This is a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in a global investment firm, working closely with our teams across France, the US, Singapore, and Tokyo.

Key Responsibilities


 * Supporting the performance review process (feedback collection, meeting organization, preparation of materials/content, etc)
 * Supporting the ARCHIMED ACADEMY : content creation for trainings and onboarding; coordination with suppliers, on-site trainings organization, assessment and evaluation, training plan updates
 * Helping prepare presentations and HR materials
 * Supporting HR documentation and process updates (training, onboarding and performance process)
 * Ad hoc HR admin support to other HR functions
   
   

Requirements

Profile & Qualifications


 * Education: Currently enrolled in a Master's degree (HR, Business School, Psychology, Management or related field)
 * Strong interest in Human Resources, talent development, and organizational processes
 * Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
 * Strong interpersonal skills and ability to interact with international teams
 * Proactive mindset with the ability to take ownership of tasks and suggest improvements
 * High attention to detail and rigor in execution
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills in French and English (international environment)
 * Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Microsoft Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint), some knowledge on content creation is plus
   
   

What We Offer


 * A 6-month internship starting in January 2027 within a leading global healthcare investment firm
 * A highly international and dynamic environment (38+ nationalities across offices in Europe, North America, and Asia)
 * Direct exposure to HR processes across onboarding, training, recruitment, performance management, and employee development
 * Hands-on experience working closely with international teams (France, US, Singapore, Tokyo)
 * The opportunity to contribute to strategic HR projects, including ARCHIMED Academy and global training initiatives
 * Close mentorship and support from an experienced HR team
 * Ownership of deliverables
 * A collaborative and impact-driven culture within a leading healthcare-focused investment firm
   
   

ARCHIMED: www.archimed.group
